$comment: Remote MCP servers the phone assistant connects to - the same connectors you use in claude.ai. Copy each server's URL from claude.ai -> Settings -> Connectors (or from the vendor). auth.type: oauth (login from /admin), bearer (token from an env var), headers, or none. alwaysLoad = tools kept in Claude's context on every request (the rest are found with tool search). Set enabled=false to skip a server.
